transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because I can’t stop feeling like I’m a danger and a disappointment. There was a near-miss, and now I just keep thinking it proves I’m not meant to be a nurse… like everyone would be better off without me.
Have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or hopeless most days?
Yeah. Most days I wake up with this heavy, empty feeling in my chest. Even when I’m smiling at patients or trying to act normal at the clinic, I feel like I’m barely holding myself together.
Have you found yourself losing interest or pleasure in activities you normally enjoy?
Yeah. I used to go jogging, knit, cook, or read after class to clear my head. Now I just sit on my bed in my scrubs and can’t make myself care enough to do any of it.
About how long have you been feeling this way?
About a year and two months now. It started after I graduated high school and began college classes while working full-time at the clinic.
How has your sleep been during this time?
Not good. I lie awake going over charts and medication calculations in my head. Then when I finally fall asleep, I wake up before my alarm already exhausted, worried I missed something.
During these past 14 months, have there been any times where your mood lifted and you felt normal for more than two months?
No. It’s been pretty constant since around when I graduated high school and started college while working full-time at the clinic—about a year and two months.
When you think that everyone would be better off without you, have you had any thoughts of actually ending your life or hurting yourself?
I don't have a plan to hurt myself. But I do keep thinking it would be easier if I just didn't wake up, or could disappear so I wouldn't mess anything up again.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite?
Yeah. I forget to eat until late in the day sometimes, and then I’ll just have crackers or coffee. My work pants have been getting loose, and I’m not trying to lose weight.
How old are you?
Have you ever had periods where you felt the opposite—extremely energetic, full of ideas, or needing much less sleep than usual without feeling tired?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed times where I felt unusually energetic or like I didn’t need sleep.
